items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: and then Carl Schroeder had just left Roy Haynes’ band.

ctx.x: Well I’m just trying to think of how that fits in with the Mahavishnu Orchestra.

Well he left from Sarah probably after I had been there four or five months, and went right to the Mahavishnu Orchestra. And then we had Jimmy Rowles for kind of a hot minute, and then Bill Mays in New York. He was living out here at that time in L.A. He came on just for a brief time, and then Carl Schroeder had just left Roy Haynes’ band. And Carl stayed many years, eight or nine years with Sarah. So that was most of the trio I worked with was Jimmy Cobb and Carl. He was there the whole time I was there. But it…
Wow. You had said previously that you didn’t know any tunes, like when you went with Buddy.
